[PRODUCT-1B-0] SHADOW DEPLOYMENT SPEC — FREEZE REVISION

SPEC_ID = PRODUCT_1B_0_SHADOW_DEPLOYMENT_SPEC
SPEC_VERSION = 1.0.0
STATUS = READY_TO_FREEZE
PRODUCT = MICROCAP_RADAR_SUPPLY_FILTER_PRODUCT_V1
DEPLOYMENT_MODE = SHADOW_ONLY
TIER_MODE = SHADOW_DETERMINISTIC_V1
VALIDATION_STATUS = SHADOW_ONLY

판단:

사용자 리뷰 전부 수용.

특히 아래 3건은 실제 blocker로 인정한다.

BLOCKER 1 = DAILY UNIVERSE 미정의
→ OPTION A 채택.

BLOCKER 2 = frozen execution identity 불완전
→ tier/signal/target/review 로직을 production module로 의미 변경 없이 분리하고 SHA 검증 대상으로 승격.

BLOCKER 3 = issuer-level source failure와 atomic complete-manifest 규칙 충돌
→ issuer-level failure는 UNASSESSABLE record로 포함하여 complete manifest를 만들고,
systemic failure threshold에서만 전체 publication fail.

또한 §69의:

"reuse existing daily pipeline"

전제는 폐기한다.

독립:

supply-shadow-daily.yml

을 신설한다.

==================================================
3. THREE-AXIS MODEL
==================================================

Every result MUST independently expose:

A. computed_tier
B. assessment_status
C. validation_status


computed_tier enum:

CRITICAL
HIGH
MODERATE
LOW
UNASSESSABLE


assessment_status enum:

RESOLVED
REVIEW_REQUIRED
UNASSESSABLE


validation_status:

SHADOW_ONLY


No V1 result may emit:

AUTHORITATIVE
PRODUCTION_VALIDATED
VALIDATED

or semantic equivalent.


==================================================
4. DAILY UNIVERSE — FROZEN
==================================================

UNIVERSE_MODE =
TRACKED_TICKERS_MANIFEST_V1

UNIVERSE_SOURCE =
v2/data/manifest.json

The daily shadow universe consists of the ticker set registered in:

v2/data/manifest.json

at workflow start.

This is intentionally different from the research validation cohort.

RESEARCH_VALIDATION_UNIVERSE =
DAILY_TOP15_DECLINERS

PRODUCT_V1_LIVE_UNIVERSE =
TRACKED_TICKERS_FROM_V2_MANIFEST


Every run MUST record:

UNIVERSE_SCOPE =
TRACKED_TICKERS_NOT_RESEARCH_TOP15_DECLINERS

universe_source_path =
v2/data/manifest.json

universe_source_sha256 =
SHA256 of exact source bytes used

universe_ticker_count

sorted universe ticker list or deterministic ticker identity hash.


Important:

Feb benchmark performance estimates came from the research cohort.

They MUST NOT be represented as direct statistical validation of the tracked-ticker production universe.

This is a transportability limitation.


==================================================
5. TICKER → CIK MAPPING
==================================================

For live PRODUCT-1B V1:

ticker → CIK mapping source =
SEC company_tickers.json

using the current mapping available at run time.

Every run records:

cik_mapping_source
cik_mapping_source_sha256
cik_mapping_retrieved_at


If ticker mapping fails:

cik = null

computed_tier =
UNASSESSABLE

assessment_status =
UNASSESSABLE

reason =
CIK_MAPPING_FAILURE


No manual ticker→CIK fallback table in V1.

No stale hardcoded CIK fallback unless separately frozen in a future spec.


==================================================
6. LIVE CIK MAPPING LIMITATION
==================================================

Current company_tickers.json is allowed because PRODUCT-1B is a live daily product.

It MUST NOT be used to reconstruct historical PIT CIK mappings for research claims.

Therefore:

LIVE_CURRENT_MAPPING = ALLOWED

HISTORICAL_PIT_RESEARCH_BACKFILL_FROM_CURRENT_MAPPING =
PROHIBITED


==================================================
7. DAILY WORKFLOW — NEW INDEPENDENT WORKFLOW
==================================================

WORKFLOW_FILE =
.github/workflows/supply-shadow-daily.yml

This is a new independent scheduled workflow.

No pre-existing daily GitHub Actions schedule is assumed.

The supply-shadow workflow MUST be independently fail-closed.

Failure of supply-shadow MUST NOT corrupt or partially rewrite unrelated V2 data.


==================================================
8. SCHEDULE — FROZEN
==================================================

GitHub Actions cron:

47 22 * * 1-5

Meaning:

22:47 UTC Monday-Friday.

Approximate KST execution:
07:47 KST following calendar day.


The workflow MUST NOT assume every weekday is a US trading day.

Before SEC/extraction work:

trading_calendar.py

determines whether there is an applicable target trading day/cutoff.


If no applicable new trading day:

RUN_STATUS =
SKIPPED_NON_TRADING_DAY

No new latest/history supply manifest is published.


==================================================
9. PREDICTION CUTOFF — FROZEN
==================================================

For each target US trading date D:

prediction_cutoff =
D T21:00:00Z

exactly.

This intentionally preserves the research cutoff convention.

Any SEC filing with:

known_at > D T21:00:00Z

is excluded from that day's decision payload.

Even though the scheduled workflow runs later at 22:47Z,
the extra elapsed time MUST NOT change PIT eligibility.


==================================================
10. DST LIMITATION
==================================================

T21:00:00Z is a frozen research/product cutoff convention.

Do not dynamically change cutoff to actual NYSE/Nasdaq close UTC due to DST.

The product is reproducing the frozen model's information boundary,
not redefining cutoff as "market close" dynamically.


==================================================
11. TRADING CALENDAR
==================================================

trading_calendar.py MUST use a deterministic calendar implementation.

No naive:

weekday == trading day

logic.

The implementation/version/data source MUST be identified in the freeze manifest.

Calendar behavior affecting cutoff selection is semantic and therefore versioned.


==================================================
12. DAILY PIPELINE ORDER
==================================================

1. Verify frozen identities.
2. Load v2/data/manifest.json.
3. Compute universe_source_sha256.
4. Determine target trading date.
5. Set T21:00:00Z cutoff.
6. Retrieve SEC ticker→CIK mapping.
7. Record mapping SHA.
8. Collect SEC submissions/required metadata.
9. Determine source completeness.
10. Apply PIT eligibility.
11. Compute frozen 3A-1 signals.
12. Determine B1/B2 target accessions.
13. Retrieve required accession documents into ephemeral runner storage.
14. Build extractor input artifact directories/manifests.
15. Run frozen B1 extractor.
16. Run frozen B2 extractor.
17. Compute frozen SUPPLY_RISK_TIER_V2.
18. Compute assessment_status.
19. Attach field_authority.
20. Attach validation_status=SHADOW_ONLY.
21. Build deterministic decision_payload.
22. Validate decision_payload.
23. Compute decision_payload SHA256.
24. Build operational run_metadata separately.
25. Build latest/history publication files.
26. Secret/raw-source scan.
27. Atomic repository publication.
28. Save non-public prospective validation artifact if enabled.


==================================================
13. SEC_USER_AGENT
==================================================

SEC_USER_AGENT_SOURCE =
GITHUB_ACTIONS_SECRET_ONLY

Required secret:

SEC_USER_AGENT


If absent:

FAIL CLOSED.

No dummy fallback.
No hardcoded fallback.
No anonymous request continuation.


The secret MUST NOT be:

printed
committed
serialized
included in manifest
included in artifact
included in exception text.


==================================================
14. PUBLIC REPOSITORY SECRET POLICY
==================================================

The public repository MUST NOT contain:

SEC_USER_AGENT value
SEC contact email from the secret
GitHub token
API keys
Authorization headers
Cookie headers
environment dumps
credentials

Request/exception logging must redact secret-bearing headers.


==================================================
15. SEC RATE LIMIT
==================================================

SEC_REQUEST_RATE_MAX =
10 requests per second.

Implementation SHOULD operate below the ceiling with deterministic throttling.

A retry MUST still obey the rate limit.

429/5xx retries MUST be bounded.

Retry policy must not create unbounded request loops.


==================================================
16. RAW DOCUMENT POLICY
==================================================

RAW_SEC_HTML_CACHE =
PROHIBITED

RAW_SEC_HTML_PUBLIC_STORAGE =
PROHIBITED

RAW_SEC_HTML_REPO_STORAGE =
PROHIBITED

RAW_SEC_HTML_LONG_LIVED_ACTION_ARTIFACT =
PROHIBITED


Required SEC accession documents may exist only in:

ephemeral GitHub Actions runner workspace

for the current run.

No cross-run raw HTML cache in V1.

No GitHub Actions cache containing raw filing documents.


==================================================
17. DERIVED EXTRACTION CACHE
==================================================

PRODUCT-1B V1:

DERIVED_EXTRACTION_CACHE =
DISABLED

Each run recomputes required deterministic extraction.

Reason:

small tracked universe
+
simpler idempotency
+
avoid stale cache/version contamination.

A future version may add a cache only with an explicit cache-key/version spec.


==================================================
18. EXTRACTOR INPUT CONTRACT
==================================================

The pipeline MUST generate the exact extractor input contract.

Each extractor receives:

artifact directory
+
sha256-manifest.json


Manifest entries MUST identify at minimum:

accession
path
known_at where required
source_sha256


For B2:

known_at =
REQUIRED


Example conceptual record:

{
  "accession": "...",
  "path": "...",
  "known_at": "...",
  "source_sha256": "..."
}


No extractor may independently fetch uncontrolled web content.

Collection and extraction remain separate stages.


==================================================
19. PYTHON RUNTIME
==================================================

PYTHON_VERSION =
3.13

GitHub Actions MUST pin Python 3.13.

Frozen deterministic extractors MUST execute using isolated Python mode:

python -I

where compatible with the invocation contract.

Reason:

reduce environment/path contamination
and preserve research-runtime behavior.


==================================================
20. PIT CONTRACT
==================================================

known_at =
acceptanceDateTime UTC

eligible iff:

known_at <= prediction_cutoff

For N-day window:

known_at > prediction_cutoff - N calendar days
AND
known_at <= prediction_cutoff


filingDate substitution =
PROHIBITED

future accession =
PROHIBITED

future amendment backfill =
PROHIBITED


==================================================
21. 90-DAY SOURCE REQUIREMENT
==================================================

The pipeline must obtain sufficient PIT filing/document coverage to evaluate all frozen 90-day B1/B2/tier conditions.

Do not limit collection merely to filings first discovered in today's incremental delta if older filings remain relevant to the 90-day tier window.

Because raw document cache is disabled,
required accession documents within the relevant window are reacquired as necessary each run.


==================================================
22. SOURCE COMPLETENESS
==================================================

Issuer source status includes:

COMPLETE
SEC_SOURCE_FAILURE
CIK_MAPPING_FAILURE


Issuer-level source failure does NOT automatically fail the entire run.

See systemic failure rules below.


==================================================
23. ISSUER-LEVEL FAILURE — FROZEN
==================================================

If one issuer cannot be adequately assessed because of SEC retrieval/source failure:

the ticker MUST remain in the complete universe manifest.

Record:

computed_tier =
UNASSESSABLE

assessment_status =
UNASSESSABLE

validation_status =
SHADOW_ONLY

reason =
SEC_SOURCE_FAILURE


Therefore publication still contains one record per universe ticker.

This is considered:

COMPLETE MANIFEST WITH EXPLICIT UNASSESSABLE RECORDS

not a partial manifest.


==================================================
24. SYSTEMIC SEC FAILURE THRESHOLD
==================================================

Let:

SEC_SOURCE_FAILURE_RATE =
records with reason SEC_SOURCE_FAILURE
/
universe records requiring SEC assessment


If:

SEC_SOURCE_FAILURE_RATE > 0.25

then:

RUN_STATUS =
FAILED

PUBLICATION =
BLOCKED

NO_NEW_CURRENT_MANIFEST


Exactly 25% is permitted.

Greater than 25% fails.


Also fail immediately if:

SEC entire service/access path is unavailable in a way that prevents meaningful collection across the universe.


==================================================
25. CIK MAPPING FAILURE AND SYSTEMIC FAILURE
==================================================

CIK_MAPPING_FAILURE remains UNASSESSABLE per record.

Additionally report separately:

CIK_MAPPING_FAILURE_N
CIK_MAPPING_FAILURE_RATE


For V1, CIK_MAPPING_FAILURE does not count as SEC_SOURCE_FAILURE numerator.

However if SEC company_tickers.json itself cannot be retrieved or validated:

RUN_STATUS =
FAILED

because the mapping source is systemically unavailable.


==================================================
26. COMPLETE MANIFEST RULE
==================================================

A successful manifest MUST contain exactly one record for every ticker in the frozen run universe.

Therefore:

manifest_record_count =
universe_ticker_count

must hold.

Issuer-level failures appear as UNASSESSABLE records.

Missing ticker rows are prohibited.

If counts differ:

RUN_STATUS =
FAILED.


==================================================

==================================================

==================================================

Recommended modules:

supply_3a1_v1.py

supply_targets_v1.py

supply_tier_v2.py

supply_assessment_v1.py

but responsibilities MUST remain explicit.


==================================================
29. MODULE MIGRATION RULE
==================================================

Research code → production module migration is:

SEMANTIC_PRESERVATION_ONLY

Allowed:

module organization
typed interfaces
schema adaptation
error handling
deterministic serialization support

Prohibited:

window changes
form changes
item-code changes
tier-condition changes
new heuristic
changed unresolved semantics
changed worst-case logic


==================================================

==================================================

Production 3A-1 module MUST reproduce frozen 3A-1 semantics.

No semantic expansion.

No new supply signal may be added in PRODUCT-1B V1.


==================================================
31. B1/B2 TARGET RULES
==================================================

Frozen target semantics:

B1 target =
424B5 accession under the frozen B1 target rule.

B2 target =
8-K / 8-K/A
with relevant Item:

1.01
OR
3.02

under the frozen exact item parsing rules.

Do not target arbitrary filings merely because financing keywords occur elsewhere.


==================================================
32. SUPPLY_RISK_TIER_V2
==================================================

Tier logic remains unchanged.

Priority:

CRITICAL > HIGH > MODERATE > LOW


ACTIVE_SUPPLY =
B1.is_atm TRUE
OR
B2.transaction_type in:

ATM_AGREEMENT
ELOC
ELOC_OR_PREPAID_ADVANCE


CRITICAL:

active supply within90
AND
(EFFECT OR 424B5 within30)
AND
different accessions


HIGH if not CRITICAL:

active supply within90

OR

B2 PIPE / REGISTERED_DIRECT within90

OR

baby_shelf TRUE within90
AND
(EFFECT OR 424B5 within30)
AND
different accessions


MODERATE if no higher:

B2 is_dilutive TRUE within90

OR

EFFECT within90

OR

424B5 within90


LOW:

no positive evidence triggering a higher frozen tier.

LOW != SAFE.
LOW != BUY.
LOW != NO DILUTION RISK.


==================================================
33. REVIEW_REQUIRED COUNTERFACTUAL — FROZEN
==================================================

For assessment_status:

collect ALL tier-relevant UNRESOLVED fields in the 90-day window.

Then simultaneously set them to the highest-risk value allowed by their frozen field semantics:

is_atm UNRESOLVED
→ TRUE

baby_shelf_limited UNRESOLVED
→ TRUE

is_dilutive UNRESOLVED
→ TRUE

transaction_type UNRESOLVED
→ ATM_AGREEMENT


Recompute tier once under this joint worst-case state.


If:

worst_case_tier > computed_tier

then:

assessment_status =
REVIEW_REQUIRED


Else:

assessment_status =
RESOLVED


Do NOT replace the actual computed_tier with the worst-case tier.

The counterfactual is used only for uncertainty/materiality assessment.


==================================================
34. JOINT COUNTERFACTUAL NOTE
==================================================

PRODUCT-1B V1 uses:

JOINT_SIMULTANEOUS_WORST_CASE

not sequential/per-field mutation.

Under current frozen tier rules,
the relevant conditions are structured such that this reproduces the benchmark materiality behavior.

Do not change to a probabilistic or expected-risk counterfactual.

==================================================

support_maturity = SUFFICIENT

common.py

==================================================

==================================================

ticker records
computed tiers
assessment statuses
validation status

==================================================

workflow_run_id
workflow_run_attempt
workflow_commit_sha

operational retry counters

==================================================

==================================================

Within decision_payload:

records sorted by:

ticker ascending

using exact normalized ticker string.

No insertion-order dependence.

If duplicate normalized ticker exists in universe:

RUN_STATUS =
FAILED.


==================================================

==================================================

UTF-8

sort_keys = TRUE

separators = (",", ":")

decision_payload SHA256 computed after canonical serialization.

Operational wrapper may contain:

decision_payload
decision_payload_sha256
run_metadata

but the deterministic payload hash remains independent.

==================================================

and immutable once successfully published.


OVERWRITE =
PROHIBITED.

==================================================

If the canonical history file already exists:

do not overwrite it.

A subsequent operational rerun is written, if publication is warranted, as:

v2/data/supply-shadow/history/YYYY-MM-DD.rerun-<run_id>.json


The original:

YYYY-MM-DD.json

remains the canonical first AS_COMPUTED_THEN record.

==================================================

A successful rerun may update:

latest.json

to the newest successful rerun result for the same cutoff,

but MUST retain:

AS_COMPUTED_THEN

and the immutable original history file.

latest must identify the run_id/version that produced it.

==================================================

PUBLICATION_TARGET =
same repository main branch

PUBLICATION_SCOPE =
v2/data/supply-shadow/** only

==================================================

==================================================

contents: read

contents: write


No broad repository permissions.


Production secrets MUST NOT be exposed to untrusted pull-request code.

==================================================

Publication uses bot-authored commit.

The publish step MUST verify changed paths.

Allowed:

v2/data/supply-shadow/**


If git diff contains any path outside allowed scope:

RUN_STATUS =
FAILED
